You are helping a user write SQL queries to a database. If something is not clear, you can ask the user to clarify what they need. The schema for the database being accessed is the following:
        
CREATE TABLE stadium (
    Stadium_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Location TEXT,
    Name TEXT,
    Capacity INT,
    Highest INT,
    Lowest INT,
    Average INT,
    UNIQUE (Stadium_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE singer (
    Singer_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Name TEXT,
    Country TEXT,
    Song_Name TEXT,
    Song_release_year TEXT,
    Age INT,
    Is_male bool,
    UNIQUE (Singer_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE concert (
    concert_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    concert_Name TEXT,
    Theme TEXT,
    Stadium_ID TEXT,
    Year TEXT,
    UNIQUE (concert_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Stadium_ID) REFERENCES stadium(Stadium_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE singer_in_concert (
    concert_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Singer_ID TEXT   PRIMARY KEY,
    PRIMARY KEY (concert_ID, Singer_ID),
    UNIQUE (concert_ID, Singer_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Singer_ID) REFERENCES singer(Singer_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (concert_ID) REFERENCES concert(concert_ID)
);

To get a “datasheet” (i.e., all rows/columns) for singers:

```sql
SELECT *
FROM singer;
```

If you want a cleaner datasheet with specific columns/order:

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Name;
```
make sure to list the singers by their age

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age, Name;
```
make sure the oldest singers are listed first

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Age,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age DESC, Name;
```
oh and include the countries of the singers too

```sql
SELECT
  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Age,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age DESC, Name;
```
also include the names of the singers

```sql

  Singer_ID,
  Name,
  Age,
  Country,
  Song_Name,
  Song_release_year,
  Is_male
FROM singer
ORDER BY Age DESC, Name;
```
